Now Abraham had taken another wife, named Keturah,
And Abraham took another wife named Keturah.
亞伯拉罕又娶了一妻，名叫基土拉。
and she bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
She became the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah.
基土拉給他生了心蘭、約珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴，和書亞。
Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were the Asshurites, the Letushites, and the Leummites.
And Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan. And from Dedan came the Asshurim and Letushim and Leummim.
約珊生了示巴和底但。底但的子孫是亞書利族、利都是族，和利烏米族。
The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
And from Midian came Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the offspring of Keturah.
米甸的兒子是以法、以弗、哈諾、亞比大，和以勒大。這都是基土拉的子孫。
Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.
Now Abraham gave all his property to Isaac;
亞伯拉罕將一切所有的都給了以撒。
But while he was still alive, Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.
But to the sons of his other women he gave offerings, and sent them away, while he was still living, into the east country.
亞伯拉罕把財物分給他庶出的眾子，趁著自己還在世的時候打發他們離開他的兒子以撒，往東方去。
Abraham lived a total of 175 years.
Now the years of Abraham's life were a hundred and seventy-five.
亞伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五歲。
And at a ripe old age he breathed his last and died, old and contented, and was gathered to his people.
And Abraham came to his death, an old man, full of years; and he was put to rest with his people.
亞伯拉罕壽高年邁，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖（原文是本民）那裡。
His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.
And Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, put him to rest in the hollow rock of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, near Mamre;
他兩個兒子以撒、以實瑪利把他埋葬在麥比拉洞裡。這洞在幔利前、赫人瑣轄的兒子以弗崙的田中，
This was the field that Abraham had bought from the Hittites. Abraham was buried there with his wife Sarah.
The same field which Abraham got from the children of Heth: there Abraham was put to rest with Sarah, his wife.
就是亞伯拉罕向赫人買的那塊田。亞伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那裡。
After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who lived near Beer-lahai-roi.
Now after the death of Abraham, the blessing of God was with Isaac, his son.
亞伯拉罕死了以後，神賜福給他的兒子以撒。以撒靠近庇耳‧拉海‧萊居住。
This is the account of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s maidservant, bore to Abraham.
Now these are the generations of Ishmael, the son of Abraham, whose mother was Hagar the Egyptian, the servant of Sarah:
撒拉的使女埃及人夏甲給亞伯拉罕所生的兒子是以實瑪利。
These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
These are the names of the sons of Ishmael by their generations: Ishmael's first son was Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam
以實瑪利兒子們的名字，按著他們的家譜記在下面。以實瑪利的長子是尼拜約，又有基達、亞德別、米比衫、
Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
And Mishma and Dumah and Massa,
米施瑪、度瑪、瑪撒、
Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
Hadad and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
哈大、提瑪、伊突、拿非施、基底瑪。
These were the sons of Ishmael, and these were their names by their villages and encampments—twelve princes of their tribes.
These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names in their towns and their tent-circles; twelve chiefs with their peoples.
這是以實瑪利眾子的名字，照著他們的村莊、營寨，作了十二族的族長。
Ishmael lived a total of 137 years. Then he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
And the years of Ishmael's life were a hundred and thirty-seven: and he came to his end, and was put to rest with his people.
以實瑪利享壽一百三十七歲，氣絕而死，歸到他列祖（原文是本民）那裡。
Ishmael’s descendants settled from Havilah to Shur, which is near the border of Egypt as you go toward Asshur. And they lived in hostility toward all their brothers.
And their country was from Havilah to Shur which is east of Egypt: they took their place to the east of all their brothers.
他子孫的住處在他眾弟兄東邊，從哈腓拉直到埃及前的書珥，正在亞述的道上。
This is the account of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,
Now these are the generations of Abraham's son Isaac:
亞伯拉罕的兒子以撒的後代記在下面。亞伯拉罕生以撒。
and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean.
Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramaean of Paddan-aram, and the sister of Laban the Aramaean, to be his wife.
以撒娶利百加為妻的時候正四十歲。利百加是巴旦‧亞蘭地的亞蘭人彼土利的女兒，是亞蘭人拉班的妹子。
Later, Isaac prayed to the LORD on behalf of his wife, because she was barren. And the LORD heard his prayer, and his wife Rebekah conceived.
Isaac made prayer to the Lord for his wife because she had no children; and the Lord gave ear to his prayer, and Rebekah became with child.
以撒因他妻子不生育，就為她祈求耶和華；耶和華應允他的祈求，他的妻子利百加就懷了孕。
But the children inside her struggled with each other, and she said, “Why is this happening to me?” So Rebekah went to inquire of the LORD,
And the children were fighting together inside her, and she said, If it is to be so, why am I like this? So she went to put her question to the Lord.
孩子們在她腹中彼此相爭，她就說：「若是這樣，我為甚麼活著呢（或譯：我為甚麼如此呢）？」她就去求問耶和華。
and He declared to her: “Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger.”
And the Lord said to her, Two nations are in your body, and two peoples will come to birth from you: the one will be stronger than the other, and the older will be the servant of the younger.
耶和華對她說：兩國在你腹內；兩族要從你身上出來。這族必強於那族；將來大的要服事小的。
When her time came to give birth, there were indeed twins in her womb.
And when the time came for her to give birth, there were two children in her body.
生產的日子到了，腹中果然是雙子。
The first one came out red, covered with hair like a fur coat; so they named him Esau.
And the first came out red from head to foot like a robe of hair, and they gave him the name of Esau.
先產的身體發紅，渾身有毛，如同皮衣，他們就給他起名叫以掃（就是有毛的意思）。
After this, his brother came out grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when the twins were born.
And after him, his brother came out, gripping Esau's foot; and he was named Jacob: Isaac was sixty years old when she gave birth to them.
隨後又生了以掃的兄弟，手抓住以掃的腳跟，因此給他起名叫雅各（就是抓住的意思）。利百加生下兩個兒子的時候，以撒年正六十歲。
When the boys grew up, Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while Jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.
And the boys came to full growth; and Esau became a man of the open country, an expert bowman; but Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
兩個孩子漸漸長大，以掃善於打獵，常在田野；雅各為人安靜，常住在帳棚裡。
Because Isaac had a taste for wild game, he loved Esau; but Rebekah loved Jacob.
Now Isaac's love was for Esau, because Esau's meat was greatly to his taste: but Rebekah had more love for Jacob.
以撒愛以掃，因為常吃他的野味；利百加卻愛雅各。
One day, while Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the field and was famished.
And one day Jacob was cooking some soup when Esau came in from the fields in great need of food;
有一天，雅各熬湯，以掃從田野回來累昏了。
He said to Jacob, “Let me eat some of that red stew, for I am famished.” (That is why he was also called Edom.)
And Esau said to Jacob, Give me a full meal of that red soup, for I am overcome with need for food: for this reason he was named Edom.
以掃對雅各說：「我累昏了，求你把這紅湯給我喝。」因此以掃又叫以東（就是紅的意思）。
“First sell me your birthright,” Jacob replied.
And Jacob said, First of all give me your birthright.
雅各說：「你今日把長子的名分賣給我吧。」
“Look,” said Esau, “I am about to die, so what good is a birthright to me?”
And Esau said, Truly, I am at the point of death: what profit is the birthright to me?
以掃說：「我將要死，這長子的名分於我有甚麼益處呢？」
“Swear to me first,” Jacob said. So Esau swore to Jacob and sold him the birthright.
And Jacob said, First of all give me your oath; and he gave him his oath, handing over his birthright to Jacob.
雅各說：「你今日對我起誓吧。」以掃就對他起了誓，把長子的名分賣給雅各。
Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau, who ate and drank and then got up and went away. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
Then Jacob gave him bread and soup; and he took food and drink and went away, caring little for his birthright.
於是雅各將餅和紅豆湯給了以掃，以掃吃了喝了，便起來走了。這就是以掃輕看了他長子的名分。
